packages.name: EthOS AntiVirus
packages.description: ClamAV-powered on-demand antivirus scanner for NAS shares. Read-only scans, signature updates, and a simple web panel. Independent EthOS package, not affiliated with Synology.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: Initial release: ClamAV scanning panel with clean/infected results and EICAR-ready verification.

packages.name: EthOS Welcome
packages.description: A tiny static welcome page for your NAS, served by nginx on port 8090.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: Initial release: static welcome page with a live clock.

packages.name: Tic-Tac-Toe
